Google Meet attendance for clinical supervision & group therapy

Clinical supervisors, behavioral health therapists, licensed counselors, and medical residency programs require meticulous, timestamped attendance logs to satisfy state licensing board audits and medical billing requirements. Here is how to automate supervision hours and group session attendance in Google Meet.
Clinical Supervision Hours Tracking
Supervision hour logs and attendance exported to Google Sheets

Accreditation-Ready Logs: State behavioral health boards (LCSW, LMFT, LPC, PsyD) and residency review committees (ACGME) require precise documentation of supervision hours. Attendance Tracker automatically logs exact timestamps, duration in minutes, and attendees into a secure Google Spreadsheet.
Key Clinical & Telehealth Requirements
Supervisee Hour Verification: Documenting the exact number of hours an associate or intern spent in group supervision vs. individual case consultation.
Didactic Lecture Compliance: Tracking medical residents and psychology trainees in required didactic lectures.
Multi-Week Supervision Series: Calculating cumulative supervision hours across a 6-month or 12-month practicum placement.
How Attendance Tracker Delivers Compliance
1. Direct Google Meet REST API Integration

Because Attendance Tracker integrates directly with the Google Meet REST API rather than scraping screen elements, it records precise server-side connection and disconnection timestamps for each supervisee or patient.
2. Tabbed Spreadsheet Generation

Each supervision session or didactic lecture automatically generates a distinct tab in your Meet Attendance Tracker spreadsheet in Google Drive. Supervisors can review or export records for licensing board sign-offs in seconds.
3. Series Hour Roll-Ups
For recurring weekly supervision calls, the add-on automatically tallies cumulative hours completed by each intern across the full academic year.
